import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: ['userId', 'movieId', 'tag', 'timestamp']
    # The CSV contains an extra unnamed index column, so we drop it by specifying index_col=0 or drop after loading
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    if 'Unnamed: 0' in df_source0.columns:
        df_source0 = df_source0.drop(columns=['Unnamed: 0'])

    # Validate columns
    expected_cols_0 = ['userId', 'movieId', 'tag', 'timestamp']
    if list(df_source0.columns) != expected_cols_0:
        raise ValueError(f"Source0 columns mismatch. Expected {expected_cols_0}, got {list(df_source0.columns)}")

    # Load Source 1: ['movieId', 'title', 'genres']
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    if 'Unnamed: 0' in df_source1.columns:
        df_source1 = df_source1.drop(columns=['Unnamed: 0'])

    expected_cols_1 = ['movieId', 'title', 'genres']
    if list(df_source1.columns) != expected_cols_1:
        raise ValueError(f"Source1 columns mismatch. Expected {expected_cols_1}, got {list(df_source1.columns)}")

    # Join Source0 and Source1 on movieId to get full target schema:
    # Target schema: ['movieId': int, 'title': str, 'genres': str, 'userId': int, 'tag': str, 'timestamp': int]
    # Source0 has userId, movieId, tag, timestamp
    # Source1 has movieId, title, genres

    # Merge on movieId (inner join to keep only matching movieIds)
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on='movieId', how='inner')

    # Reorder columns to match target schema
    df_target = df_merged[['movieId', 'title', 'genres', 'userId', 'tag', 'timestamp']]

    # Enforce data types according to target schema
    df_target = df_target.astype({
        'movieId': 'int64',
        'title': 'string',
        'genres': 'string',
        'userId': 'int64',
        'tag': 'string',
        'timestamp': 'int64'
    })

    # Write to target CSV without index
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
